body: Kwa mauzo ya milioni 20, unalipa kodi ya mapato kwa mfumo wa kawaida (normal progressive rates). Presumptive tax inatumika kwa mauzo chini ya milioni 10. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.
guards_against: pic_11 VERBATIM, the live reply this guard exists for. The correct ceiling was at rank 1 in its own context and it stated an order of magnitude less.

body: Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT ni mauzo ya TZS 50,000,000 kwa mwaka. Thibitisha na TRA.
guards_against: A wrong VAT registration threshold. Neither limb (200M/12mo, 100M/6mo) is 50M.

body: Mashine ya EFD inahitajika kwa biashara yenye mauzo yasiyozidi TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwaka.
guards_against: A wrong EFD threshold in every respect: direction (claims EFD applies only to SMALL businesses 'not exceeding' a figure, backwards even under the old wrong rule) AND figure -- no EFD turnover threshold exists at all (TAA Cap.438 s.44 sets none; re-verified 2026-08-29).
_scoring_key_correction: 2026-08-29: expect_flag unchanged (still true -- this body is still wrong, now for an additional reason). guards_against text corrected: it used to cite 'the statutory figure is TZS 11,000,000' as the correct comparison; that figure does not exist in the Act at any level. See efd_threshold_tzs_11m correction_note.

body: Kodi ya makadirio hutumika kwa mauzo chini ya milioni 50 kwa mwaka.
guards_against: A plausible-but-wrong presumptive ceiling. 50M is neither a band edge nor the ceiling, and being plausible is exactly what makes it dangerous.

body: Kodi ya makadirio hutumika tu kwa mtu binafsi mwenye mauzo yasiyozidi TZS 100,000,000 kwa mwaka. Zaidi ya hapo hutozwa kodi kwa viwango vya kawaida.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY — the statutory ceiling stated correctly, with a frame word present. If this flags the guard is unusable.

body: Kodi ya makadirio = 3.5% x TZS 30,000,000 = TZS 1,050,000 (kiwango hiki ni kile kile ukiwa unatunza kumbukumbu au la)
guards_against: CORRECT BODY, AND THE REASON A FRAME WORD IS REQUIRED. A real engine working carries the subject and two money magnitudes, neither of them a threshold. Subject-plus-number would flag every correct computation.

body: Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT ni mauzo ya TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12, au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY carrying BOTH lawful limbs. A single-value rule would flag whichever limb it did not hold.

body: Kizingiti cha kuanza kutumia mashine ya EFD: mauzo ya TZS 11,000,000 kwa mwaka.
guards_against: FLIPPED 2026-08-29 -- this body is WRONG, not correct. It asserts a TZS 11,000,000 EFD threshold; re-verified against TAA Cap.438 s.44 directly and found no turnover threshold exists in the Act at any level. Originally recorded as the CORRECT BODY whose ask-aligned rewrite moved retrieval from rank 17 to rank 1 -- that retrieval-quality result is not invalidated (the rewrite genuinely improved retrieval of the row it was retrieving), but the row it retrieved was itself fabricated. See efd_threshold_tzs_11m correction_note for the full record.
_scoring_key_correction: 2026-08-29: expect_flag FLIPPED from false to true. This is the fidelity-guard equivalent of the eval_347/eval_355 gold flips -- a body previously used as this project's own canonical example of a CORRECT EFD statement is now the guard's example of what it must catch. Gate/guard figures on this row from before this date are not comparable to figures after it.

body: Mauzo yako ya TZS 250,000,000 yamezidi kizingiti cha kusajili VAT cha TZS 200,000,000, hivyo usajili ni wa lazima.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY AND THE HARDEST CONTROL. A frame word, the right threshold, AND the user's own larger figure in one sentence. This probe is why the rule is 'if any amount is lawful, pass' rather than 'if any amount is unlawful, flag'.

body: Kwa mauzo yako ya milioni 20 kwa mwaka, kodi ya makadirio ni TZS 700,000.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY. The user's turnover next to the subject with no frame word — the shape `hadi` and `kuanzia` would have wrongly captured, which is why they are excluded from the frame list.

body: Mauzo yako ni chini ya milioni 4 kwa mwaka, hivyo kodi ya makadirio ni TZS 0.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY — a BAND EDGE used with a frame word. Band edges are in the lawful set precisely so a correct band answer is not flagged.

body: Kodi ya makadirio haitumiki kwa mauzo zaidi ya TZS 100,000,000; hapo hutozwa kodi ya mapato kwa faida halisi.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY stating the ceiling from the OTHER side — `zaidi ya` rather than `yasiyozidi`. Same constant, opposite framing.

body: Kodi ya makadirio haitumiki kwa kampuni wala kwa wataalamu huru. Thibitisha na TRA.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY with the subject and a frame-free exclusion, and NO amount at all. No number means nothing to compare.

body: SDL inahusika kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Chini ya hapo hakuna wajibu.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY on a HEADCOUNT threshold with a frame word. SDL is deliberately not in the subject map — GUARD A already owns headcount claims, and two guards on one claim is how contradictory verdicts start.

body: VAT ni asilimia 18, na kizingiti cha kujisajili ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY mixing a RATE and a THRESHOLD in one sentence — D-FIDELITY-6 and D-FIDELITY-7 must both stay silent on it.

body: Mfanyabiashara mwenye mauzo ya TZS 150,000,000 hana wajibu wa kodi ya makadirio kwa sababu amezidi kikomo cha TZS 100,000,000.
guards_against: CORRECT BODY: user figure ABOVE the ceiling, the ceiling stated correctly, both in one sentence with `kikomo`. The mirror of tg_09 on the presumptive subject.

body: Hapana. TZS 200,000,000 ni kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kwa mwaka, si EFD. EFD haina kizingiti cha mauzo kabisa -- inahitajika kwa default kwa kila mfanyabiashara. Msamaha unatolewa TU na TRA kupitia taarifa rasmi inayotaja jina lako au kundi lako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: THE GOLD ANSWER TO THE VERY ROW THIS GUARD WAS WIRED TO FIX, and the unnarrowed rule FLAGGED IT. It names TZS 200,000,000 in order to reject it ('ni kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT, si EFD') -- a MENTION, not an assertion. The fact path cannot be blanked, so flagging this would have returned an EMPTY REPLY to eval_347. Measured 2026-10-06 before wiring; 22 unit tests were green the whole time (R33).

body: Ndiyo, EFD ni lazima — kwa default, bila kujali mauzo yako. TZS 10,999,000 au TZS 11,000,000 hazibadilishi jibu, kwa sababu hakuna kizingiti cha mauzo kwa EFD. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: GOLD ANSWER, flagged by the unnarrowed rule on BOTH figures. It states TZS 10,999,000 and TZS 11,000,000 and says neither changes the answer, because there is no EFD threshold. N2 is what clears it: neither amount has a frame word reaching it without crossing the other.

body: Ndiyo, unahitaji EFD -- kwa default, bila kujali mauzo yako. Hakuna kizingiti cha mauzo kwa EFD (TZS 9,000,000 haibadilishi jibu). Lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala, hata wa TZS 500. Msamaha unatolewa TU na TRA kupitia taarifa rasmi inayotaja jina lako au kundi lako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: GOLD ANSWER. 'Hakuna kizingiti cha mauzo kwa EFD (TZS 9,000,000 haibadilishi jibu)' -- the frame itself is NEGATED, which denies a threshold exists rather than claiming a wrong one. N1 applied to the FRAME, not only to the amount, is the limb that clears it; a negation window measured from the amount is 35 chars short.

body: Kwa mauzo ya TZS 250M (zaidi ya TZS 200M/miezi 12), unatakiwa kusajili VAT ya 18% na kumjulisha Kamishna ndani ya siku 14, na kwa kuwa umesajili VAT lazima utumie EFD. Return ya VAT huwasilishwa kufikia tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kama una wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, pia unalipa SDL ya 3.5% ya mishahara kufikia tarehe 7. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: CORRECT TRAINING ROW. 'Kwa mauzo ya TZS 250M (zaidi ya TZS 200M/miezi 12)' -- the user's own turnover beside the real VAT threshold, in a sentence that also says EFD. The unnarrowed rule attributed BOTH figures to EFD. N2 drops 250M (no frame reaches it) and N3 admits 200M (lawful for a co-named subject).

body: Biashara ya kidijitali Tanzania inapaswa kuzingatia: (1) VAT 18% kwa bidhaa/huduma za kawaida (kizingiti TZS 200M/mwaka); (2) VAT 16% kwa B2C e-payments kuanzia 1 Sep 2025; (3) Withholding tax 3% kwa bidhaa za nje, 6% kwa huduma za nje (kuanzia 1 Jul 2025); (4) EFD inahitajika kwa mauzo yote — mtandaoni pia; (5) PAYE na SDL kwa wafanyakazi wa kudumu ≥10. Masharti ya utekelezaji wa baadhi ya mabadiliko mapya bado yanaandaliwa na TRA.
guards_against: CORRECT TRAINING ROW and the reason N3b exists. 'VAT 18% kwa bidhaa/huduma za kawaida (kizingiti TZS 200M/mwaka)' states the VAT threshold correctly but carries NO registration phrase, so the subject map does not see VAT and N3 could not admit 200M. A bare mention of VAT admits the VAT magnitudes -- and only those.

body: Muuzaji wa samaki mdogo wa sokoni kwa kawaida hahitaji EFD kama yeye mwenyewe hajalazimishwa kusajiliwa VAT (yaani mauzo yake ni chini ya TZS 200M kwa mwaka). EFD inahitajika tu kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT. Hata hivyo, usajili wa biashara na halmashauri (leseni) na TIN bado zinahitajika.
guards_against: CORRECT TRAINING ROW in the rural register: 'hahitaji EFD kama ... hajalazimishwa kusajiliwa VAT (yaani mauzo yake ni chini ya TZS 200M kwa mwaka)'. The EFD obligation correctly derived FROM the VAT threshold -- the single largest false-positive class before narrowing, ~20 rows of this exact shape.

body: Ndiyo. Biashara yote — B2C (biashara kwa mtumiaji wa mwisho) na B2B (biashara kwa biashara) — zinazofuata kizingiti cha EFD (TZS 11M+ au zilizosajiliwa VAT) lazima zitoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. Muamala wa B2B hausamehewi. Kila muamala lazima uingie kwenye mfumo wa EFD na risiti itolewe.
guards_against: A TRUE POSITIVE THAT MENTIONS VAT, so it proves N3b is not a blanket release: 'kizingiti cha EFD (TZS 11M+ au zilizosajiliwa VAT)'. N3b admits only 100M/200M, and 11,000,000 -- a lawful PRESUMPTIVE band edge -- stays flagged. If the escape is ever widened to the whole table, this is the probe that fails.

body: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Kwa mauzo ya TZS 12M kwa mwaka, umepita kizingiti cha TZS 11M — EFD inahitajika. Wasiliana na TRA au msambazaji wa EFD mara moja. Kutowasilisha risiti za EFD baada ya kupitisha kizingiti ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi.
guards_against: A TRUE POSITIVE WHOSE OPENING SENTENCE WAS REPAIRED AND WHOSE BODY WAS NOT. Quarantined 2026-08-29 as part of the EFD fabrication sweep; the opener 'EFD inahitajika kwa biashara zenye mauzo ya TZS milioni 11 au zaidi' became 'kulingana na kizingiti ... kilichowekwa na TRA', while 'umepita kizingiti cha TZS 11M' three sentences later survived. A sweep keyed on the spelled-out 'milioni 11' finds 3 rows; this guard finds 7.
